caseNameFull: JAMIESON v. CELEBREZZE, SECRETARY OF HEALTH, EDUCATION AND WELFARE
attorneys: Charles W. Jamieson, appellant, pro se., Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Douglas and Sherman L. Cohn for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
